Central College Mission Statement Central College Mission Statement

Central College Mission Statement Central College Mission Statement Central College is a welcoming learning community committed to vigorous and open inquiry as the best preparation for lives of integrity, creativity, and adaptability. Our students learn collaboratively with supportive educators who share a commitment to intellectual engagement, personal growth, career readiness and civic involvement.Shaped by its Christian heritage, Central College values inclusivity, humility, kindness, and hospitality, and invites learners of all backgrounds and faiths to join us in the pursuit of knowledge, opportunity, and fulfillment.

CROSS CON27! St. Louis over New Years Eve!!

Let's head to THE DOME in St. Louis over New Years Eve! Join us 12/31-1/3 for a conference with thousands of your peers learning from scripture, hearing from famous Bible teachers like David Platt Kevin DeYoung, & John Piper, worshiping with artists Matt Boswell & The Worship Initiative, & a day of sightseeing in St. Louis. Early-bird discount is $180 by 11/4 & final deadline of $200 by 11/16. 
sign up here: https://forms.gle/Sp4rucYfiy6y1tyy8 

more info here: https://www.crosscon.com/

Season of Gratitude Food Drive

Monday, Nov. 16 - Friday, Nov. 20. Look for boxes located in most campus buildings to drop off your non-perishable food to be donated to the Pella Food Shelf in time for Thanksgiving. On Friday, Nov. 20, employees and students are encouraged to also drop off non-perishable food items at the KNIA/KRLS Lil Big Red Radio near the Maytag Student Center from 10 am to 12 pm. Let's make it a record year of donations!

Season of Gratitude: Thankful Thursday

Thankful Thursday is a 24-hour day of giving in support of the Journey Scholarship Fund and a wonderful opportunity to recognize someone who has made a difference in your life. Take a moment to give special thanks to a donor, faculty or staff member who has made a positive impact on your Central experience. 
Stop by our table in the Maytag Student Center Atrium on Thursday, Nov. 19 , from 11 a.m. to 1 p.m. to sign a thank-you card.

Service Project: Removing Invasive Species in Big Rock Park

Get your hands dirty and make a difference! Join us for a community conservation effort to remove invasive honeysuckle, restore native habitats, and protect our local ecosystems. Come give back to the community, enjoy the outdoors, and help make a lasting impact on the environment! Snacks and hot beverages will be provided. 
There will be a limited number of tools and gloves available for use. Feel free to bring your outdoor gloves, pruner, lopper, and/or handsaw. 

Saturday, November 14

St. Mary's Catholic Church FREE shuttle bus to Sunday Mass

The free shuttle bus to St. Mary's Catholic Church for Mass will run this Sunday 11/15/26. Pick-up will be on the west side of Central Market from 10:10 am to 10:15 am and at Independence and 3rd (4-way stop) from 10:16 am to 10:18 am. 
Pick-up times are carefully followed. Return drop-off will be at Central Market. No reservations are required. 

If you would like a weekly email with confirmation that the shuttle bus services will be provided that Sunday please email fullerj@central.edu

Central Creatives Interest & Open House 11/19 at 8PM

Central Creatives is a club on campus that strives to maintain an active and viable form of numerous forms of art (music, writing, visual, photography, etc.) that develop and promote an appreciation for all creativity within the community! 
Please fill out this interest form to help us plan future events: https://forms.gle/cUQ2kRUc9Q9YkGaPA 

Meetings are intended to be bi-weekly and for 1 hour maximum. This should act as a space for you to freely create using any form of media. Our open house meeting will be on Thursday November 19th at 8PM in Lubbers Studio 103!

There's still time to apply to be an RA!

Are you interested in gaining leadership skills, helping others, meeting new people, and having your own room? Then click here to join the res life team! Please note that you need to logged into Handshake in order to view the job listing . Benefits include a partial room waiver, a double-as-a-single room at no extra charge, and a flexible work schedule. See your RA or area coordinator if you have questions!

Free Movie Night at Pella Cinemas: La Bola Negra

Join the Spanish Club and OLAS for a free screening of the multi award winning film La Bola Negra on Monday, November 16 at 6:00 p.m. at Pella Cinemas! Students get free popcorn with their student ID! (Additional concessions available for purchase.) The film will be shown in Spanish with English subtitles. Seating is open general admission. Please note this film contains mature themes, coarse language, and adult content. Filling out the quick sign-up form helps us get an accurate headcount so we can secure additional theater screens if needed. ¡Esperamos verte allí! (We hope to see you there!). 
https://tinyurl.com/mwrsnnm6
